description: Get an adversarial second opinion from a different model family (Gemini Pro). ALWAYS use this for plan critiques, design reviews, and pre-merge code review: it hunts for flaws, edge cases, security issues, and unstated assumptions you may have missed.

content.description: Inline content to review (plan, diff, code snippet).

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory / project root. Defaults to the server's cwd.

files.description: File paths to review instead of inline content.

model.description: Override the model: a name or id from `agy models`, or a `*` version pattern such as "Gemini * Pro (High)". Normally omit — the tool routes automatically.

name: adversarial_review
